meta.title: Session manager
meta.description: Lists every session by workspace in Settings > Session manager, with a lock toggle and a delete button on each row. Deleting asks for confirmation first, then moves the session into a recycle bin at the bottom of the page and out of the workspace list for good: the log file is moved into the recycle bin, so the session stays invisible even with archived sessions shown. Restore brings it back exactly as it was during a configurable window (24 hours by default, 0 deletes for good immediately); each row also has Delete now, which asks for confirmation once more. Expired sessions are deleted for real, logs included.
